# `Q-18-15` — Execution Record Skipped

> The document uses an engine that builds no execution record, so it is stored in the
> older capture format.

## What this means

An engine can describe what it ran in an *execution record*. Some engines, including engines
provided by extensions, do not build one. When a document mixes such an engine with engines
that do, Quarto stores the whole document in the older capture format, so that none of the
output is lost.

Every cell still ran and every output is shown. This is a note, not a problem: nothing needs
fixing.

## What may not work

Features that read execution records, like reusing saved results or sharing them with other
editors, may not work with this document.

## What you can do

Nothing needs to change. If you write the engine, you can add record support; see
[Execution records](../../guides/authoring/execution-records.qmd).
